entries.name: Gmail
entries.auth_note: OAuth sign-in with an OAuth client you create in Google Cloud (Developer Preview).
oauth_setup: Create or pick a Google Cloud project and join the Google Workspace Developer Preview Program (https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview).
Enable the Gmail (gmail.googleapis.com) API and the Gmail MCP (gmailmcp.googleapis.com) API for the project.
In Google Auth Platform, set up Branding, Audience and Data Access. Under Data Access add the scopes listed below. With an External audience, add yourself as a test user.
Go to Google Auth Platform > Clients > Create Client (https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/clients/create) and choose "Web application".
Under Authorized redirect URIs add the redirect URI shown below, exactly.
Select "Use this client for an AI-powered agent", click Create, and copy the client ID and client secret into this form.

entries.name: Slack
entries.auth_note: OAuth sign-in with a Slack app you create (no automatic registration).
oauth_setup: Create a Slack app at https://api.slack.com/apps and follow Slack's MCP server guide for the scopes it needs.
Add the redirect URI shown below to the app's OAuth redirect URLs.
Copy the app's client ID and client secret into this form.

entries.name: Slack (Zencoder)
entries.description: Maintained fork of the archived reference Slack server, using a bot token.
entries.auth_note: Install first: npm install -g @zencoderai/slack-mcp-server. Needs a Slack bot token and team ID.

entries.name: GitHub
entries.description: Repositories, issues, pull requests and Actions.
entries.auth_note: GitHub personal access token as a bearer token.

entries.name: GitHub (local, Docker)
entries.description: The same GitHub tools, run locally in Docker.
entries.auth_note: Needs Docker and a GitHub personal access token.

entries.name: Notion
entries.auth_note: Bearer MCP token from the Notion developer portal (Business/Enterprise plans), or OAuth sign-in.

entries.name: Notion (local, legacy)
entries.description: Integration-token server. Notion says it is no longer maintained.
entries.auth_note: Notion integration token.

entries.name: Linear
entries.auth_note: Linear API key as a bearer token. Read-only endpoint: /mcp/readonly.

entries.name: Atlassian (Jira & Confluence)
entries.description: Jira and Confluence through Atlassian Rovo.
entries.auth_note: Service-account API key as a bearer token, or a custom Authorization header with "Basic base64(email:api_token)". An org admin must enable API-token auth.

entries.name: Sentry
entries.auth_note: Custom Authorization header with the value "Sentry-Bearer <token>". Otherwise OAuth.

entries.name: Sentry (local)
entries.auth_note: Sentry auth token. Set SENTRY_HOST too for self-hosted Sentry.

entries.name: Stripe
entries.auth_note: Stripe Agent API key as a bearer token. Full secret keys stop working on 30 Nov 2026.

entries.name: Cloudflare
entries.auth_note: Cloudflare user or account API token as a bearer token.

entries.name: Supabase
entries.auth_note: Supabase personal access token as a bearer token. Add ?project_ref=…&read_only=true to scope it.
